description: A manifest hashes what is about to be published, so emit runs after the build: with no output on disk there is nothing to hash, and a manifest without `files` would make every consumer's staleness check vacuous. Nothing about the package has been read at this point — not a single mark — so this exits the way a missing `tsconfig.json` does rather than the way a mark that will not verify does. A publishing script reads those apart.
